The tools should be able to scan web applications (especially our test target Mutillidae within one hour), they should run on Microsoft Windows 7, be freeware or provide at least a free trial version and come with a command line or web interface.

newer than 2005

The selected tools (see Filter in data analysis) are installed on a Windows 7 Professional system with 8 Gigabyte memory. An Intel Core i5 2500 quad core processor with 3,30 Gigahertz serves as CPU. All the test runs of the tools are executed separately with no other processes running on the system. The anti-virus program and the Windows Firewall are inactive during the whole scan. As test target we use the vulnerable web application Mutillidae, version 2.1.19. It is part of Metasploitable which is installed in a Virtual Box on Windows 7.
We want to know a ranking of: installation simplicity, processor load, clarity and intuitiveness, detected vulnerabilities, run duration and accuracy of the report.
